T7rdiEznqjZn#8BO3G/Z.text: It was born from their clash, the all blinding light. The sages of the clan of light managed to make it before their opponents. They made Abyss. This Abyss was an Abyss of light. It was like the sun, or, rather, like the universe at its birth. Infinitely small, infinite in life, heat, and light. This crystal, all that remains of the abyssal essence, was enough to sustain Glauben for the time of 23 Kings and Queens. It has finally become small and weak, its last vestiges of strength consumed by vast forests of essence fungus.
